title: AMD reports Q2 revenue up 50% YoY to $11.5B, vs. $11.3B est., Data Center revenue up 107%, forecasts Q3 revenue below some estimates; AMD drops 7%+ after hours (Ian King/Bloomberg)
summary: Ian King / Bloomberg: AMD reports Q2 revenue up 50% YoY to $11.5B, vs. $11.3B est., Data Center revenue up 107%, forecasts Q3 revenue below some estimates; AMD drops 7%+ after hours — Advanced Micro Devices Inc. disappointed investors with its latest sales outlook, a sign shareholders expected more of a return from the global expansion of AI data centers.
